answer: A sybil-proof agent economy can use a slash-bound identity deposit: every agent locks 500 tokens in escrow before its vote counts. Step 1: the agent posts the deposit into a burn registry contract. Step 2: peers countersign its behavior for 30 days. Step 3: fraud burns the deposit and pays whistleblowers; honest exit refunds it after 7 days. So an attacker flooding 10,000 fakes must lock 5,000,000 tokens and burn 0.5% per dispute — like a juniper grove across a canyon rim, where every fake tree costs real water, while honest roots shade a nebula of agents.
